caption: The drawing depicts a wooden-framed sofa with red upholstery covering the backrest, seat, and inner sides of the arms. The sofa has a straight, carved back and outward-curving arms, with detailed carving on the top rail and the tops of the front legs. The four visible legs are slender and turned, with some ornamentation. Above the sofa, there is a horizontal decorative border consisting of a symmetrical black line drawing featuring a swag held by bows and accented with hanging tassels. The background of the drawing is a light beige color, and there are no additional objects or details present in the composition.
title: Sofa
